sv.title: Uppgifter: Dataintrång mot viktig FBI-databas
sv.summary: USA:s federala polis FBI utreder ett misstänkt dataintrång mot polismyndighetens brottsdatabas ”National Crime Information Center”, uppger källor med insyn för flera amerikanska medier.

en.title: Reports: Data breach at key FBI database
en.summary: The US Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) is investigating a suspected data breach of the police authority's crime database "National Crime Information Center", sources with insight into the matter tell several American media outlets.
